n: A guide is someone who has done the thing before and goes with you while you do it. Most people learn AI tools faster with one: a coworker who shows you the first three steps and then sits back while you take the fourth. You can be a guide too. This week, show one person one thing you learned, at their desk, on their own work, and let them drive.
